question: How many times has Nitish Kumar taken oath as the Chief Minister of Bihar?
solution:
The correct answer is 10__** times**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nitish Kumar** took oath as** Bihar's Chief Minister** for the 10**th time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• He assumed office after state legislative assembly election 2025.
 
• The oath-taking ceremony witnessed the presence of prominent political figures.
 
• This marks a significant shift in Bihar's political landscape.
 
• Kumar's tenure has seen alliances and realignments with various political parties.
 
• His decision to join hands with the BJP-JD(U) government indicates a new phase in Bihar's politics.
